name: Temperature at 2 Meters
definition: The average air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Precipitation Corrected
definition: The average MERRA-2 bias corrected total precipitation at the surface of the earth.

name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters
definition: The average of wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Cloud Amount
definition: The average percent of cloud amount during the temporal period.

name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions. An alternative term for the total solar irradiance is the "Global Horizontal Irradiance" or GHI.

name: Air Mass
definition: Air Mass according to Perez et al. 1990.

name: All Sky Insolation Clearness Index
definition: A fraction representing clearness of the atmosphere; the all sky insolation that is transmitted through the atmosphere to strike the surface of the earth divided by the average of top of the atmosphere total solar irradiance incident.

name: All Sky Normalized Insolation Clearness Index
definition: The average zenith angle-independent expression of the all sky insolation clearness index.

name: All Sky Surface Longwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The downward thermal infrared irradiance under all sky conditions reaching a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth. Also known as Horizontal Infrared Radiation Intensity from the Sky.

name: All Sky Surface Longwave Upward Irradiance
definition: The upward thermal infrared irradiance under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Diffuse PAR
definition: The diffuse (scattered from original direct path by molecules or particles) Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Direct Horizontal PAR
definition: The Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Total PAR
definition: The total (direct plus diffuse) Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Diffuse Irradiance
definition: The diffuse (scattered from original direct path by molecules or particles) solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Direct Horizontal Irradiance
definition: The solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Direct Normal Irradiance
definition: The direct solar irradiance incident to a horizontal plane normal (perpendicular) to the direction of the sun's position under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Upward Irradiance
definition: The upward shortwave irradiance under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface UVA Irradiance
definition: The ultraviolet A (UVA 315nm-400nm) irradiance under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface UVB Irradiance
definition: The ultraviolet B (UVB 280nm-315nm) irradiance under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface UV Index
definition: The ultraviolet radiation exposure index.

name: All Sky Surface Albedo
definition: The all sky rate of reflectivity of the earth's surface; the ratio of the solar energy reflected by the surface of the earth compared to the total solar energy incident reaching the surface of the earth.

name: Aerosol Optical Depth 55
definition: The optical thickness at 0.55 um measured vertically; the component of the atmosphere to quantify the removal of radiant energy from an incident beam.

name: Adjusted Aerosol Optical Depth 55
definition: The adjusted optical thickness at 0.55 um measured vertically; the component of the atmosphere to quantify the removal of radiant energy from an incident beam.

name: Aerosol Optical Depth 84
definition: The optical thickness at 0.84 um measured vertically; the component of the atmosphere to quantify the removal of radiant energy from an incident beam.

name: Cooling Degree Days Above 0 C
definition: The daily accumulation of degrees above a 0-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is above the threshold.

name: Cooling Degree Days Above 10 C
definition: The daily accumulation of degrees above a 10-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is above the threshold.

name: Cooling Degree Days Above 18.3 C
definition: The daily accumulation of degrees above an 18.3-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is above the threshold.

name: Cloud Amount at Daytime
definition: The average percent of cloud amount during daylight.

name: Cloud Amount at Nighttime
definition: The average percent of cloud amount during nighttime.

name: Cloud Optical Visible Depth
definition: The vertical optical thickness between the top and bottom of a cloud.

name: Clear Sky Days
definition: The number of Clear Sky Days if the daytime cloud amount is less than 10 percent.

name: Clear Sky Insolation Clearness Index
definition: A fraction representing clearness of the atmosphere; the clear sky insolation that is transmitted through the atmosphere to strike the surface of the earth divided by the average of top of the atmosphere total solar irradiance incident.

name: Clear Sky Surface Longwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The downward thermal infrared irradiance under clear sky conditions reaching a horizontal plane on the surface of the earth. Also known as Horizontal Infrared Radiation Intensity from Sky.

name: Clear Sky Surface Longwave Upward Irradiance
definition: The upward thermal infrared irradiance under clear sky conditions.

name: Clear Sky Surface Diffuse PAR
definition: The diffuse (scattered from original direct path by molecules or particles) Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions.

name: Clear Sky Surface Direct Horizontal PAR
definition: The Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions.

name: Clear Sky Surface Total PAR
definition: The total Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions.

name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Diffuse Irradiance
definition: The diffuse (scattered from original direct path by molecules or particles) solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions.

name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Direct Horizontal Irradiance
definition: The solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions.

name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Direct Normal Irradiance
definition: The direct solar irradiance incident to a horizontal plane normal (perpendicular) to the direction of the sun's position under clear sky conditions.

name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions. An alternative term for the total solar irradiance is the "Global Horizontal Irradiance" or GHI.

name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Upward Irradiance
definition: The upward shortwave irradiance under clearsky conditions.

name: Clear Sky Surface Albedo
definition: The clear sky rate of reflectivity of the earth's surface; the ratio of the solar energy reflected by the surface of the earth compared to the total solar energy incident reaching the surface of the earth.

name: Zero Plane Displacement Height
definition: The height at which the mean velocity is zero due to large obstacles such as buildings/canopy.

name: Evaporation Land
definition: The evaporation over land at the surface of the earth.

name: Evapotranspiration Energy Flux
definition: The evapotranspiration energy flux at the surface of the earth.

name: Frost Days
definition: A frost day occurs when the 2m temperature cools to the dew point temperature and both are less than 0 C or 32 F.

name: Ice Covered Fraction
definition: The fraction of ocean covered by sea ice.

name: Land Snowcover Fraction
definition: The fraction of land covered by snow.

name: Growing Degree Days Above 10 C
definition: Accumulated crop heat units above a 10-degree-Celsius base temperature using the complex growing degree day method; commonly used for corn/sorghum/rice/soybeans.

name: Growing Degree Days Above 13.3 C
definition: Accumulated crop heat units above a 13.3-degree-Celsius base temperature using the complex growing degree day method; commonly used for peanut.

name: Growing Degree Days Above 15.6 C
definition: Accumulated crop heat units above a 15.6-degree-Celsius base temperature using the complex growing degree day method; commonly used for cotton.

name: Growing Degree Days Above 4.4 C
definition: Accumulated crop heat units above a 4.4-degree-Celsius base temperature using the complex growing degree day method; commonly used for wheat/barley/rye/oats.

name: Growing Degree Days Above 7.2 C
definition: Accumulated crop heat units above a 7.2-degree-Celsius base temperature using the complex growing degree day method; commonly used for potato/sunflower.

name: Profile Soil Moisture
definition: The amount of water and water vapor present in the soil. Profile indicates the layer from the surface down to the bedrock. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.

name: Root Zone Soil Wetness
definition: The amount of water and water vapor available to plants in the root zone, generally considered to be the upper 1 m of soil, expressed as the proportion of water present in a given amount of soil. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.

name: Surface Soil Wetness
definition: The amount of water and water vapor present in the soil. Top indicates the upper 5 cm of soil. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.

name: Heating Degree Days Below 0 C
definition: The daily accumulation of degrees below a 0-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is below the threshold.

name: Heating Degree Days Below 10 C
definition: The daily accumulation of degrees below a 10-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is below the threshold.

name: Heating Degree Days Below 18.3 C
definition: The daily accumulation of degrees below an 18.3-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is below the threshold.

name: Probability of Liquid Precipitation
definition: Probability of liquid precipitation estimated with a diagnostic parameterization using ancillary data.

name: Total Precipitation
definition: The average IMERG total precipitation at the surface of the earth.

name: Count of Precipitation Retrievals
definition: The count of half-hourly precipitation retrievals where precipitation is at least 0.01 mm.

name: Midday Insolation Incident
definition: The total amount of solar irradiance (direct plus diffuse) incident on a horizontal plane at the earth's surface during the solar noon hour midday period.

name: All Sky Surface Longwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The downward thermal infrared irradiance under all sky conditions reaching a horizontal plane on the surface of the earth. Also known as Horizontal Infrared Radiation Intensity from Sky.

name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Diffuse Irradiance
definition: The diffuse (scattered from original direct path by molecules or particles) solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Direct Horizontal Irradiance
definition: The solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions. An alternative term for the total solar irradiance is the "Global Horizontal Irradiance" or GHI.

name: Clear Sky Surface Longwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The downward thermal infrared irradiance under clear sky conditions reaching a horizontal plane on the surface of the earth. Also known as Horizontal Infrared Radiation Intensity from Sky.

name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions. An alternative term for the total solar irradiance is the "Global Horizontal Irradiance" or GHI.

name: Planetary Boundary Layer Top Pressure
definition: The pressure at the top of the planet boundary layer.

name: Snow Precipitation
definition: The snow precipitation at the surface of the earth.

name: Snow Precipitation Land
definition: The snow precipitation only over land at the surface of the earth.

name: Surface Pressure
definition: The atmospheric pressure at the surface of the earth.

name: Peak Sun Hour
definition: The average intensity of solar irradiance that reaches the surface.

name: Precipitable Water
definition: The total atmospheric water vapor contained in a vertical column of the atmosphere, sourced from CERES.

name: Specific Humidity at 10 Meters
definition: The ratio of the mass of water vapor to the total mass of air at 10 meters.

name: Specific Humidity at 2 Meters
definition: The ratio of the mass of water vapor to the total mass of air at 2 meters.

name: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters
definition: The ratio of vapor pressure to the saturation vapor pressure with respect to a plane surface of pure water, expressed in percent.

name: Surface Air Density
definition: The air density at surface of the earth.

name: Sea Level Pressure
definition: The sea level pressure at the surface of the earth.

name: Snow Depth
definition: The snow depth on land at surface of the earth.

name: Surface Albedo Adjusted
definition: The ratio of the solar energy reflected by the surface of the earth compared to the total solar energy incident reaching the surface of the earth. Adjusted refers to CERES source parameter.

name: Temperature at 10 Meters
definition: The air (dry bulb) temperature at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Temperature at 10 Meters Maximum
definition: The maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Temperature at 10 Meters Minimum
definition: The minimum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Temperature at 10 Meters Range
definition: The minimum and maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature range at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Dew/Frost Point at 2 Meters
definition: The dew/frost point temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Wet Bulb Temperature at 2 Meters
definition: The adiabatic saturation temperature which can be measured by a thermometer covered in a water-soaked cloth over which air is passed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Temperature at 2 Meters Maximum
definition: The maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Temperature at 2 Meters Minimum
definition: The minimum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Temperature at 2 Meters Range
definition: The difference between the minimum and maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Total Column Ozone
definition: The total amount of ozone in a column extending vertically from the earth's surface to the top of the atmosphere.

name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Direct Normal Radiation
definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane where oriented to the sun's position at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Downward Irradiance
definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

name: Total Column Precipitable Water
definition: The total atmospheric water vapor contained in a vertical column of unit cross-sectional area extending from the surface to the top of the atmosphere, sourced from the GMAO.

name: Tropopause Pressure based on blended estimate.
definition: The tropopause pressure based on the blended estimate.

name: Tropopause Specific Humidity using blended TROPP estimate.
definition: The ratio of the mass of water vapor to the total mass of air at the tropopause pressure given by TROPPB.

name: Tropopause Temperature using blended TROPP estimate.
definition: The air (dry bulb) temperature at the tropopause pressure given by TROPPB.

name: Earth Skin Temperature
definition: The average temperature at the earth's surface.

name: Soil Temperatures Layer 1
definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 1; 0.018 to 0.0988 m depth.

name: Soil Temperatures Layer 2
definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 2; 0.0988 to 0.294 m depth.

name: Soil Temperatures Layer 3
definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 3; 0.294 to 0.6799 m depth.

name: Soil Temperatures Layer 4
definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 4; 0.6799 to 1.4425 m depth.

name: Soil Temperatures Layer 5
definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 5; 1.4425 to 2.949 m depth.

name: Soil Temperatures Layer 6
definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 6; 2.949 to 10.0 m depth.

name: Surface Temperature of Land and Snow
definition: The estimate of surface temperature of land and snow; 0 to 0.018 m depth.

name: Earth Skin Temperature Adjusted
definition: The adjusted average temperature at the earth's surface. Adjusted refers to CERES source parameter.

name: Earth Skin Temperature Maximum
definition: The maximum hourly earth skin temperature in the period of interest.

name: Earth Skin Temperature Minimum
definition: The minimum hourly earth skin temperature in the period of interest.

name: Earth Skin Temperature Range
definition: The minimum and maximum hourly earth skin temperature range in the period of interest.

name: Eastward Wind at 10 Meters
definition: The estimate of the eastward wind average speed for winds blowing 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Eastward Wind at 2 Meters
definition: The estimate of the eastward wind average speed for winds blowing 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Eastward Wind at 50 Meters
definition: The estimate of the eastward wind average speed for winds blowing 50 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Northward Wind at 10 Meters
definition: The estimate of the northward wind average speed for winds blowing 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Northward Wind at 2 Meters
definition: The estimate of the northward wind average speed for winds blowing 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Northward Wind at 50 Meters
definition: The estimate of the northward wind average speed for winds blowing 50 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters Maximum
definition: The maximum hourly wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters Minimum
definition: The minimum hourly wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters Range
definition: The minimum and maximum hourly wind speed range at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Wind Speed at 2 Meters
definition: The average of wind speed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Wind Speed at 2 Meters Maximum
definition: The maximum hourly wind speed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Wind Speed at 2 Meters Minimum
definition: The minimum hourly wind speed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Wind Speed at 2 Meters Range
definition: The minimum and maximum hourly wind speed range at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Wind Speed at 50 Meters
definition: The average of wind speed at 50 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Wind Speed at 50 Meters Maximum
definition: The maximum hourly wind speed at 50 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Wind Speed at 50 Meters Minimum
definition: The minimum hourly wind speed at 50 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

name: Wind Speed at 50 Meters Range
definition: The minimum and maximum hourly wind speed range at 50 meters above the surface of the earth.

name: Surface Roughness
definition: The height above the displacement plane at which the mean wind becomes zero when extrapolating the logarithmic wind speed profile downward through the surface layer.

name: Clear Sky Normalized Insolation Clearness Index
definition: The average zenith angle-independent expression of the clear sky insolation clearness index.

name: Solar Zenith Angle
definition: The angle between the geodetic zenith vector and a vector from the earth point to the sun integrated over the period.
